findingsAddressed.title: Change Verification record is stale after the latest revise-apply Runs
findingsAddressed.rootCause: 091-revise-apply (D1-RA-002) and 093-revise-apply (D1-RA-003) updated Run result.json, production code, and the proposal bundle, but did not sync the Change-owned verification.md. The file stayed at its 087/089 state: 406/406 tests, only a D1-RA-001 check row, and result references ending at 089. docs/verification-model.md Section 7 requires verification.md as the formal Change record and states result.json cannot replace it; Section 3.3/3.4 require Verification to be updated after revise-apply before re-entering review-apply. The stale record therefore could not support a review-apply approval or the Archive boundary.
